description: Defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for the gPTP (generalized Precision Time Protocol) support in Zephyr OS, including message types, port identity, header structures, and callback mechanisms.

methods.name: gptp_register_phase_dis_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback for phase discontinuity events.

methods.name: gptp_unregister_phase_dis_cb
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered phase discontinuity callback.

methods.name: gptp_call_phase_dis_cb
methods.description: Invokes all registered phase discontinuity callbacks.

methods.name: gptp_event_capture
methods.description: Captures the current gPTP event timestamp and grandmaster presence status.

methods.name: gptp_sprint_clock_id
methods.description: Formats a clock ID into a human-readable string.

methods.name: gptp_foreach_port
methods.description: Iterates over all gPTP ports, calling a callback for each.

methods.name: gptp_get_domain
methods.description: Returns the current gPTP domain configuration or status.

methods.name: gptp_clk_src_time_invoke
methods.description: Provides time information to the ClockMaster entity.

methods.name: gptp_get_hdr
methods.description: Retrieves the gPTP header from a network packet.
